name: aurea77
description: Manage your sporting-event journey and equipment, read awarded badges and visible post text, and get insights from your Aurea77 account.

interface.longDescription: Find events, record existing external registrations and BIBs, prepare for races, organize travel and logistics, and record athlete-reported results. Read and edit your equipment, review awarded badges and visible post text, and ask for account insights. Review and confirm each update before it is saved. Organizer registrations, bookings, purchases, images and post/badge edits are excluded.
defaultPrompt: Help me record my existing event registration and BIB.
Show my equipment and help me add a new pair of shoes.
Show my awarded badges and summarize my recent post text.
